# Wonderchat

> Wonderchat is a no-code AI chatbot and agent platform that helps businesses automate customer service, sales, and enterprise knowledge search. Build and deploy intelligent, human-like AI chatbots trained on your own data — websites, documents, help desks — in under 5 minutes. Trusted by 1,000+ businesses worldwide, Wonderchat deflects up to 70% of support queries, provides 24/7 instant answers in 40+ languages, and delivers source-attributed responses that eliminate AI hallucination. SOC 2 and GDPR certified.

Key features and benefits:

- No-code AI chatbot builder: train chatbots on your websites, PDFs, DOCX files, help desk tickets, and more — no coding required.
- AI agents for customer service automation: automate up to 92% of support tickets with human-like conversational AI.
- AI agents for sales: qualify leads, collect contact information, book meetings via Calendly, and sync to your CRM automatically.
- Enterprise AI knowledge search: ingest thousands of pages and documents to deliver precise, source-attributed answers across your organization.
- Anti-hallucination with source attribution: every answer is tied back to its original source, critical for regulated industries like banking, healthcare, and government.
- Model flexibility: choose from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Llama, and Deepseek with no vendor lock-in.
- Self-learning AI: chatbots continuously learn from corrections and real conversations to improve over time.
- 40+ language support: automatically responds in the user's language.
- Human handover: seamlessly escalate complex conversations to human agents via email, helpdesk tickets, or built-in live chat.
- Omnichannel deployment: website widget, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Slack, Discord, and mobile apps via SDK.
- Native integrations: HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Shopify, Slack, Discord, Google Drive, Calendly, ActiveCampaign, Zapier, and more.
- Enterprise-grade security: SOC 2 and GDPR compliant, with custom integrations, role-based access control, and flexible deployment options.

## Products

- [AI Chatbot Builder](https://wonderchat.io/): Build and deploy a fully functional AI chatbot trained on your data in under 5 minutes. No coding required.
- [AI Agent for Customer Service](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-customer-service): Automate Tier 1 support, deflect tickets, and provide 24/7 instant answers trained on your knowledge base.
- [AI Agent for Sales](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-sales): Qualify leads, engage website visitors, and book meetings automatically through conversational AI.
- [AI Agent for Lead Generation](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-lead-generation): Create automated conversation sequences to qualify leads and collect contact information within the chat widget.
- [AI Agent for Business](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-business): Deploy AI agents across customer service, sales, and internal knowledge management for your organization.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://wonderchat.io/enterprise): Scalable, secure AI agent solutions for large organizations with custom integrations, massive knowledge bases (20,000+ pages), and dedicated support.
- [AI Agents](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agents): Overview of Wonderchat's AI agent capabilities across customer service, sales, and knowledge search.

## Use Cases

- [AI Chatbot for E-commerce](https://wonderchat.io/ai-chatbot-for-ecommerce): Automate product questions, shipping and returns inquiries, and 24/7 customer support for online stores.
- [AI Agent for Shopify](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-shopify): Native Shopify integration for AI-powered customer support and sales on your Shopify store.
- [AI Agent for Zendesk](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-zendesk): Add AI-powered ticket deflection and instant answers on top of your Zendesk help desk.
- [AI Agent for Real Estate](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-real-estate): Qualify leads and answer property questions automatically for real estate businesses.
- [AI Agent for Prospecting](https://wonderchat.io/ai-agent-for-prospecting): Automate outbound prospecting with AI-driven conversations.
- [AI Chatbot for WhatsApp](https://wonderchat.io/ai-chatbot-for-whatsapp): Deploy AI chatbots on WhatsApp for customer support and engagement.
- [Support Automation](https://wonderchat.io/landing/support-automation): Reduce support costs and response times with AI-powered ticket automation.

## Integrations

- [All Integrations](https://wonderchat.io/integrations): Connect Wonderchat to your entire tech stack — CRMs, helpdesks, e-commerce platforms, and communication tools.
- [Zendesk](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/zendesk): Sync with Zendesk to train your AI on help desk tickets and route escalations.
- [HubSpot](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/hubspot): Automatically sync leads and conversations to HubSpot CRM.
- [Freshdesk](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/freshdesk): Integrate with Freshdesk for AI-powered ticket deflection and escalation.
- [Shopify](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/shopify): Connect your Shopify store for AI-powered customer support and product recommendations.
- [Slack](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/slack): Deploy Wonderchat as an internal knowledge bot in Slack.
- [WhatsApp](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/whatsapp): Serve customers on WhatsApp with AI-powered conversations.
- [Discord](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/discord): Add AI chatbot support to your Discord server.
- [Facebook Messenger](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/facebook-messenger): Automate customer conversations on Facebook Messenger.
- [Google Drive](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/google-drive): Train your AI chatbot on documents stored in Google Drive.
- [Microsoft SharePoint](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/microsoft-sharepoint): Connect SharePoint as a knowledge source for your AI agent.
- [Calendly](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/calendly): Let visitors book meetings directly through the chat widget.
- [ActiveCampaign](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/active-campaign): Sync leads and conversations with ActiveCampaign.
- [Twilio](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/twilio): Enable voice and SMS AI agent capabilities via Twilio.
- [Zapier](https://wonderchat.io/integrations/zapier): Connect to thousands of apps through Zapier automation.

## Compare

- [Wonderchat vs. Chatbase](https://wonderchat.io/chatbase-alternative): Wonderchat offers source attribution, model flexibility, and enterprise-grade security compared to Chatbase.
- [Wonderchat vs. Botsonic](https://wonderchat.io/botsonic-alternative): Wonderchat provides deeper integrations and self-learning AI compared to Botsonic.
- [Wonderchat vs. MyAskAI](https://wonderchat.io/myaskai-alternative): Wonderchat offers broader deployment channels and enterprise features compared to MyAskAI.
- [Wonderchat vs. Chatsonic](https://wonderchat.io/chatsonic-alternative): Wonderchat is purpose-built for customer service automation, unlike Chatsonic's general-purpose AI.
